name: RTVE — Entrega de Materiales, Especificaciones Técnicas (HD)

governance.spec_version: Entrega de Materiales en RTVE — Especificaciones Técnicas (13/03/2025)
governance.source: Entrega de Materiales en RTVE — Especificaciones Técnicas (Corporación de Radio y Televisión Española, 13/03/2025)
governance.notes: RTVE (Corporación de Radio y Televisión Española; La 1, La 2). Video: MXF OP1a, XDCAM HD422 50 Mbit/s, 1920x1080i/25 (SMPTE 274M), 4:2:2, >=8-bit, ITU-R BT.709. Audio: PCM 24-bit/48 kHz, 8-track structure (some tracks may be empty); stereo Lt/Rt and/or 5.1; Dolby E on AES pairs 1-4 (48k/20-bit, TC-synced); EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-1 LU, true peak -1 dBTP (aligns with Spain's Ley 7/2010). TC start 0:00:00:00 (NOT 10:00:00:00); NO bars/tone/slate/carta de ajuste (first frame = first image); Dolby-E 5.1 files: 2 s black before first image; textless separated by 10 s black. Subtitles: binary EBU-STL (EBU Tech 3264), authoring standard UNE 153010. Audio description: EBU BWF .wav PCM 16-bit/48 kHz mono (UNE 153020). Sign language: separate MXF OP1a XDCAM 4:2:2 video. File naming Titulo_Año_MATERIAL (no accents/spaces/ñ; underscores; _UHD suffix for UHD). UHD/HDR (contracted): XAVC-Intra 300 / XAVC LongGOP 200, 2160p50, 4:2:2/4:4:4 >=10-bit, BT.2020 HLG. Metadata: accompanying 'parte de grabación' must match file. Delivery via RTVE NUBE portal. PSE not specified in this document. Language es, jurisdiction ES.

color.notes: ITU-R BT.709 (ITU-709). UHD variant: BT.2020 / HLG.

bit_depth.notes: At least 8 bits per sample ('nativos de al menos 8 bits').

codec.notes: PCM uncompressed. Dolby E permitted on AES pairs 1-4 (48 kHz/20-bit, TC-synced, no delay).

track_count.notes: 8-track structure (some tracks may be empty). UHD masters use 16 tracks. Stereo Lt/Rt and/or 5.1; commercial masters add International/M&E band on higher channels.

layout.notes: Stereo Lt/Rt and/or 5.1. Co-official-language productions must include a Spanish version.

loudness.notes: EBU R128 / Tech 3341: -23 LUFS +/-1 LU, Maximum Permitted True Peak -1 dBTP. Aligns with Spain's Ley 7/2010 (LGCA) loudness provisions. Bars & tone must NOT be included in the file.

subtitles.notes: Binary EBU-STL per EBU Tech 3264; authoring standard UNE 153010. Required per contract/languages. Audio description as EBU BWF .wav (PCM 16-bit/48 kHz mono, UNE 153020). Sign language as a separate MXF OP1a XDCAM 4:2:2 video.

metadata.notes: A 'parte de grabación' (production/QC report) accompanies delivery and must match the file metadata exactly (durations, first/last content frame, credits start). File naming: Titulo_AñoDeProducción_MATERIAL or Serie_Temporada_Capítulo_Año_MATERIAL; no accents/punctuation/spaces/ñ; underscores; _UHD suffix for UHD.

timeline.notes: Timecode starts at 0:00:00:00 (NOT 10:00:00:00). No bars/tone/slate/carta de ajuste; first frame = first image. Dolby-E 5.1 files: 2 s black before first image. Textless material separated by 10 s black after last frame.
